newsitem.title: YEMEN: Tribesmen kidnap French diplomat in Yemen.
newsitem.headline: Tribesmen kidnap French diplomat in Yemen.

text.p: Tribesmen on Monday kidnapped a French diplomat in the Yemeni capital Sanaa and took him to the province of Marib, security sources said.
They did not have details on the diplomat, but said security forces were negotiating with the al-Toaiman tribe, whose members abducted the diplomat while he was driving his car in a Sanaa street.
A French embassy official confirmed that a diplomat had been kidnapped, but refused to give any other details.

The Toaiman tribe earlier this month hijacked the car of Yemen's minister of agriculture and kidnapped his driver in Sanaa. The minister was not in the car at the time. The driver was beaten up and later set free.
The tribe demanded that the government provide it with water pumps and drilling equipment for wells in Marib, 170 km (100 miles) north of Sanaa.
In recent years, tribes in Yemen with grievances against the government or foreign oil firms have kidnapped tourists or foreigners working in Yemen for use as bargaining chips.
